meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: А ты таким голосом его и пугал?
examples.trans: And did you try to scare him in that voice?
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: leaders or superiors in an organization

examples.trans: The management signed an important order.

examples.text: Успокойся, начальство просто не знает всей правды.
examples.trans: Calm down, the leadership simply does not know the whole truth.

examples.text: Официанты всегда обсуждают личную жизнь начальства.
examples.trans: Waiters always discuss the management's personal life.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нятливый'). Qualitative adjective formed with the productive suffix '-тельный'/'-ливый'. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('quick-witted, understanding').

examples.trans: It is great when the boss is understanding.

examples.text: Это слово «понятливый» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'quick-witted' is often heard in conversation.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

examples.text: Позволяешь ты обижать свою девушку или нет?
examples.trans: Do you allow someone to insult your girlfriend or not?

meanings.note: person who owns a business or property

examples.trans: The owner of the restaurant came out into the dining room.
The restaurant owner personally greets the guests.

examples.trans: Decide for yourselves what to do.

+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.trans: Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'воленный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('fired, dismissed').

examples.text: Ты не уволена, я просто пошутила.
examples.trans: You are not fired, I was simply joking.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
Here is a document from the prosecutor's office.

examples.text: Вот бумага из прокуратуры. Слушание будет сегодня вечером.
examples.trans: Here is an order from the prosecutor's office. The hearing will be this evening.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'тверждать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to confirm', paired with 'подтвердить'.

examples.trans: Do you confirm this, Ivan Vasilyevich?

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'be, appear'.

examples.text: Это слово «являться» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'be' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'owner' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Это слово «владелица» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'owner' is often heard in conversation.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
